purpose: Controlled experiment targeting O0 temporal/regime drift.
identified_weakness: O0 uses cumulative team history for its recent_win_rate features, and rolling-origin log loss deteriorates in later folds. This can overweight old regimes.
single_controlled_change: Replace only team_a_recent_win_rate and team_b_recent_win_rate with a fixed last-20-decisive-match win rate, computed strictly from matches completed before the prediction date.
decision_rule: O1 is accepted only if its improvement is credible across the pre-specified rolling-origin and independent future-holdout evaluation; otherwise frozen O0 remains the reference.
